w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering Gavel gorges at the treeline — 1,100 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/11/7), with 7 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 15 · Craft 6 · Talk 18 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Teach it to let go."

◈ OUTSHONE — Ruby Callaghan did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
